newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes sell-off on wide technical sweep.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes sell-off on wide technical sweep.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes followed the futures market lower in Monday afternoon trading, swept lower by a technical sell-off on the NYMEX.
Some regional weather forecasts calling for warmer weather also halted the market rise ahead of midday.
Since then, losses have accumlated leaving the spot February West Texas Intermediate/Cushing some 70 cents lower at $25.35-45 a barrel.
Feb/Mar WTI has narrowed significantly to only 55 cts from more than 65-70 cts last week, pushing the Feb Postings Plus at Cushing to $2.40 from $2.45-50 on late Friday.
